wardrobe.guide.overview.sort.desc: Tap Sort to reorder wardrobes and clothes. First use also shows a detailed drag guide.

wardrobe.guide.overview.tutorial.desc: The Tutorial button opens settings: view guides, control auto-popup, or mute individual tutorials.

wardrobe.guide.matching.clothes.desc: Tap the plus on the first card to add; use the trash to remove. Save via the floating button when done.
